title: Create Protocol
tagline: An NFT utility delegation tool that lets NFT owners to delegate their utilities to the interested parties  for a specific time period & price, without transfering NFT from the owner wallet
description:
- NFT owners unable to monetize on the unutilized utilities of their NFTs
- NFT owners participating in NFT staking and renting has to rely on the platform for the airdrops and other perks since the ownership of the NFT is with the concern platform.
- Independent creators unable to access tokenized communities and content to play around with out buying full memebrships
how_its_made: We have difficulty in integrating Livepeer as we have customized ERC 721 contract. We have now figured out implementing livepeer SDK and will be added in the next phase.
